name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Maid goes with at least one of Holloway or Blackmail.
Pierce goes with at least one of Greed, Jealousy, or Gardener.
Gardener goes with exactly one of Holloway, Greed, or Inheritance.
Grimsby, Blackmail, and Doctor belong to different suspects.
Blackmail goes with neither Pierce nor Maid.
Pierce, Jealousy, and Valet belong to different suspects.
